messages:
alex: deploy-bot started canary rollout for infra-model-v3 to 10% traffic
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for infra-model-v3 -> 10% of traffic. Monitor: https://internal.metrics/canary/3076543210 :rocket:
maya: seeing 5xx spike on canary hosts, healthchecks failing on 3/5 instances
maya: error sample: "rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = memory limit exceeded" from model-worker-3
liam: confirmed, agg 5xx rate for /v1/generate on canary = 6.8% (baseline 0.2%)
priya: paging oncall
incident-bot: Paging priya (oncall) for SEV-2: canary 5xx spike for infra-model-v3
priya: I'm on it, switching to incident channel, assigning triage
priya: quick question — is this only hosted API traffic or also Dedicated customers?
maya: looks like mostly hosted API (region us-west1) but saw a handful of dedicated requests in the error logs (~12 requests)
liam: logs show healthcheck failures: GET /health -> 502 from worker-3 and 504 timeouts on worker-4
priya: OK, immediate mitigation: flip canary flag to stop routing new traffic to v3. Can someone run the flag toggle?
alex: I'll do it. running:
```
# toggle canary routing off
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/feature-flags/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"routing.canary.infra-model-v3","value":false}'
```
alex: toggled flag -> response: {"status":"ok","flag":"routing.canary.infra-model-v3","value":false}
deploy-bot: Canary routing disabled for infra-model-v3 by alex. Traffic will be drained from canary hosts over next 60s.
maya: observing drop in 5xx on frontend within last 45s, 5xx down to 0.9% overall
liam: starting a targeted rollback for the canary instances (revert to infra-model-v2 snapshot)
sre-bot: Rollback task queued: RB-3076543210; expected completion ~ 3m
alex: started rollback, monitoring logs
maya: alerting SRE lead and starting post-mortem doc: https://incidents.internal/3076543210
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-3076543210, severity SEV-2. Initial impact: ~4% of requests saw elevated errors during rollout window, estimated 2k customer requests affected. Notified product & support.
priya: Customer impact: majority were small API keys, no known enterprise SLA breaches yet. Support notified to watch for tickets and to surface anything high priority.
liam: root cause hypothesis: memory regression in quantized kernel selection for v3 on A100 drivers -> OOM under certain batch sizes
maya: saving heap dumps and kv cache traces from worker-3/4
alex: will open a revert PR for the model config and block re-rollout until fix + canary test suite passes
priya: handing off to night oncall (maya) for monitoring & follow-up. summary: canary v3 caused healthcheck failures -> flag toggled off -> rollback initiated -> canary drained. Follow runbook: https://runbooks.internal/canary-failures
maya: noted, I'll watch dashboards and escalate if any late 5xx. leaving a checklist in the incident doc
priya: adding a short customer-facing blurb for support:
"We detected elevated errors for a small subset of requests during a canary rollout. Routing to the canary has been disabled and rollback is in progress. We're monitoring and will update within 60 minutes."
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
maya: logging handoff: oncall -> maya; time 2026-03-15T22:31:00Z; next update in 30m or on change
incident-bot: Incident INC-3076543210 severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 3076543459 after rollback showed stabilization
